text: No, the evidence does not confirm whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal. The data shows that approximately 81.3 hectares of planted forest (primarily *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*) were cleared, but it does not determine the cause—whether it was legal harvesting, unauthorized clearing, or an accident. The tool only confirms the loss occurred and was mapped, not its legality or compliance with regulations. Additional legal or operational records would be needed to assess whether the activity was authorized or violated any laws.
